title: fix(browser): derive controller profile_id from profile_home name
claim: browser.controller.register on /api/ws reads session.get('profile'), a key no production session builder (_init_session, _deferred_session_record, session.create) stamps, so every real cloud controller registration is rejected with 4403.

evidence.red: Defect confirmed on pinned main: tui_gateway/methods_browser_control.py:160 still `profile_id = str(session.get("profile") or "").strip()`; builders stamp only profile_home (server.py:2724, :2817). Ran external #119346's test (session.create -> browser.controller.register) on unfixed main: FAILED KeyError 'result'; registration = {'error': {'code': 4403, 'message': 'controller_id, browser_profile_id, and server session profile are required'}}.
evidence.green: External #119346 applied cleanly to pinned main (git apply --check OK): tests/gateway/test_browser_control_cloud.py + test_browser_control_broker.py 21 passed.
evidence.negative_control: Implicit: the same test fails with 4403 on main without the one-line fix (RED above). Fork's own fix not rebuilt because an external owner exists.
evidence.source: Intended profile_id semantic is a profile NAME: api_server.py:2636 uses profile_id=_api_request_profile.get() or 'default'; server.py:_set_session_context derives profile = profile_name_for_home(sess.get('profile_home')) or _current_profile_name(). #119346 uses exactly that canonical helper. The fork's `Path(home).name if home else 'default'` is WRONG in two cases: (a) launch profile is a named profile (profile_home None -> 'default' instead of the launch name); (b) explicit 'default' requested from a named-launch backend gives profile_home=~/.hermes -> '.hermes'. Do not offer the fork's production line.
